CloudGridPreset.title: CloudGridPreset
CloudGridPreset.description: User-saved multi-stream grid configuration synced to Cloud Firestore.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this preset.

name.description: Display name of the grid preset (e.g., 4-Window Focus).

description.description: Short description of the grid preset.

gridColumns.description: Number of columns in the stream grid (1 to 5).

gridRows.description: Number of rows in the stream grid (1 to 10).

fitEntirePhone.description: Whether windows scale to fit the full phone screen.

proportionalZoom.description: Whether aspect ratio lock is enabled for window zoom.

masterAudioMuted.description: Whether master audio is muted across all windows in this preset.

windowCount.description: Number of stream windows stored in this preset.

windowsJson.description: Serialized configuration of the emulator stream windows.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the preset was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the preset was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

StreamHealthIncident.title: StreamHealthIncident
StreamHealthIncident.description: Telemetry and auto-recovery log entry recorded by the background StreamHealthMonitorService when an emulator feed freezes or drops connection.

id.description: Unique identifier for the health incident.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user.

windowId.description: ID of the emulator stream window being monitored.

windowTitle.description: Title of the emulator stream window.

streamUrl.description: URL of the monitored emulator stream.

status.description: Current health status of the stream feed.

reason.description: Diagnostic cause of the freeze or dropped connection.

recoveryAction.description: Soft-refresh recovery action executed by the background service.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the incident was logged (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the incident was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CloudChatMessage.title: CloudChatMessage
CloudChatMessage.description: Chat message in the Streamsy AI Command Assistant thread.

id.description: Unique identifier for the chat message.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user.

modelId.description: Gemini model used (gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, or gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview).

sourcesSummary.description: Search grounding citations summary if applicable.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/health_logs/{logId}.description: Stores per-user emulator feed health incidents and auto-soft-refresh recovery logs.

/users/{userId}/chat_messages/{messageId.description: Stores per-user AI Command Assistant chat messages.
